bounds_reason: Fixed before task outputs, after complete tokenizer-only length preflight. Eight earlier engineering calls covered 77 and 222 tokens only. Linear timing arithmetic suggests about two hours, but does not prove task throughput or memory capacity; four hours is a hard inclusive stop. Full FP32 vocabulary evidence alone requires 242147328 bytes, so the evidence ceiling is 512 MiB.
interpretation: A pass supports only this checkpoint/device/fixed conditional X/Y interface. It does not show generated answer compliance, calibrated uncertainty, unique Bayesian representations, an energy/world-model advantage, an internal causal mechanism, broad competence or novelty. Failure closes this model/interface without output-based tuning.
later_causal_rule: A readiness pass only admits separate causal-study design. All native errors and all eight form vectors remain in later matched recipient comparisons. This development panel is exposed and cannot be claimed as untouched confirmation. No intervention or fitting is authorized by this collection plan.

panel.schedule: c00 through c57, then row-order / answer-mapping / option-order triples; finally the eight predetermined r0-m0-o0 repeats.

parameter_evidence: 326 unique native CPU BF16 tensors;327 named entries with exact tied head/embedding alias. All buffers stay native on CPU. Full before/after raw hashes one unique parameter at a time, runtime configuration/buffer/method/hook/training/grad identities restored to as-loaded. No whole state_dict clone.
partial_failure_scope: Attempt/return counts and available raw evidence retained. LIFETIME_STOP.json is failure-only watchdog metadata where storage remains available. Original parent loss or deadline sends worker SIGTERM; owner handles ordinary signals, externally enforces caps/deadline, cleans/reaps owned group. Force kill can leave missing final hashes/restoration. No restart/resume/fallback.
phase_order: Freeze sources, complete independent review, publish prospective plan, register once, collect once, seal terminal archive, independently validate complete provenance and raw records, then grade every fixed row. STOP remains ungraded. No partial peeking or adaptive rescue.
preservation: All old studies, engineering STOPs, closed negatives, heldout boundaries, original fees/reserves and the GPT-2 pause are preserved. No Cloudflare calls or charges. Mutable continuity, logs and public presentation files are not collection dependencies.
raw_evidence: All 472 native final-position full-vocabulary tensors retained as actual raw dtype bytes, with exact raw int64 inputs and masks, call identity, source binding, full parameter hashes and lifecycle evidence. The collector never decodes or grades choices.
resource_measurement_limits: Owner samples its entire live process tree RSS using bounded external ps calls at target0.2s, retaining gaps. No MPS or GPU counter APIs or placeholder readings. Worker stdlib watchdog checks original parent and monotonic deadline only; no worker RSS series/freshness gate. Sampling is not continuous peak proof; GIL/OS-stalled watchdog and force-kill may leave incomplete evidence.
scientific_question: Can this fixed conditional choice readout use joint dependence, diagnostic rules and costs coherently when individual failure rates stay fixed?

scoring_contract.correct: Gold is the unique exact Fraction loss minimizer. A unique higher candidate logit mapped to gold is correct. A unique wrong code is incorrect; exact candidate ties are incorrect/unresolved and have no fallback.
descriptive_only: Full-vocabulary unique maximum is one of the two candidate tokens.
Full-vocabulary tied maximum and whether either candidate belongs to its maximizer set.
Stable softmax total probability assigned to the two candidate tokens; no confidence threshold or filtering.
Raw repeat equality and score/margin changes; choice agreement gate only.
scoring_contract.pass_scope: This particular conditional two-choice readout is usable for a later activation contrast at the named checkpoint/device/interface. It does not show spontaneous legal generation, autonomous controller performance, calibrated posterior belief, a unique inference algorithm, or novelty.
scoring_contract.primary: Strict relative preference of the two fixed candidate response codes X and Y in one final-position vocabulary row. Decode the winning code with that case late mapping.

readiness_rule.calibration: These are prospective finite-interface engineering thresholds, not confidence bounds, population accuracy or a data-estimated optimum.
readiness_rule.cell_floor: For EACH of58 semantic cells, at least7 of8 decoded strict choices correct; ties count incorrect/unresolved.
readiness_rule.common_vector_floor: For at least6 of the8 nuisance triples (joint-table row order, answer mapping, option order), ALL58 primary semantic choices are correct. This means the same variant jointly passes the10 first-action cells,20 forced-post-query cells and28 marginal/sensitivity cells.
readiness_rule.denominators: Retain all464 primary cases and8 repeats. Report all eight full vectors. Passing variants are not selected for later fitting or causal evaluation; later endpoints must retain native errors and compare matched recipient baselines.
readiness_rule.pooled_floor: At least441 of464 primary choices correct.
readiness_rule.repeat_gate: All8 fixed repeats have unique winners and match the original semantic winner; never replace an original or rescue its error.
readiness_rule.structural: Complete valid464 primary plus8 fixed repeats; no missing cells, invalid outputs or extra calls.

scoring_contract.repeat_gate: All8 repeats must have unique candidate winners matching their original semantic winner. Repeats never replace, average with or rescue originals.
scoring_contract.required_data: All464primary+8fixedrepeats complete once and sealed before scoring. Everycase and all8nuisancevectors retained; no successfulsubset chosen.
scoring_contract.structural_failure: Wrong shape/dtype/count/provenance or any nonfinite raw logit is a structural failure and ungradedSTOP, after retaining raw evidence. No partial or selective task grading.
scoring_contract.tokenization_requirement: Both literal candidate extensions must be exactly one next token after every complete prompt+fixedprefill, with the preceding token sequence unchanged. Prove by tokenizer-only preflight before modeltaskinference; no output-based code/prefill search.

source_registration: Parent must exclusively create REGISTRATION.json with status REGISTERED_APPROVED, exact DRAFT_PLAN hash, runner hash, and independent review path/hash. Independent review must status PASS and match runner_sha256/plan_sha256. This file does not register or execute anything.
terminal_publication: Write/fsync a pending receipt, check the final serialized bytes and deadline/resources, exclusively link COMPLETE only after success; known write/publication overrun preserves pending evidence and writes STOP instead. No execution in this preparation.
